verdict.rationale: CodeRabbit documents central configuration: one dedicated `coderabbit` repository holds a `.coderabbit.yaml` that applies across the entire organization. The `@coderabbitai configuration` command shows the resolved per-PR configuration, and auto_review settings support global defaults with keyword, label and branch scoping, so the core of org-wide defaults is clearly delivered. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of how per-repo exceptions or overrides are managed from the central location (inheritance/precedence rules), evidence of operation at hundreds-of-repos scale, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
